parameters.prompt: The exact upright white tiger warrior in the reference moves its right arm in place. Over the first second it slowly raises the right hand up beside its right ear with the claws open. Then over half a second it brings the open right hand down and across in front of its chest toward screen left, ending with the arm stretched forward and low. It holds that pose briefly, then slowly lowers the arm and returns to the exact original standing pose and holds it. The arm and claws stay sharp and fully visible in every frame. Both feet stay planted. Exactly two arms and two legs. Keep the same three-quarter left view, white tiger head, white and black striped fur, silver hair, armor, belt and kilt with their original colours. No walking, turning around, jumping, second movement, extra limbs or weapon. Fixed camera, fixed size, pure uniform bright green #00FF00 background. The whole character stays inside the frame with wide margins at all times. Do not change any colours or tint. No motion blur, motion trails, afterimages, speed lines, smears, glow, glowing claws, coloured light, energy, liquid, spray, projectiles, feathers flying off, particles, dust, rocks, cracks, shadow or text.
